In Search of The Excavation Team (2)

summary: Tarrel Rockweaver waits in the Wetlands for news of Merrin at the Whelgar Excavation Site. Two weeks have passed without a letter, and he fears for the eastern dig.

sections.title: A Husband's Dread
sections.body: For two weeks, Tarrel Rockweaver has heard nothing from his wife, Merrin. From the Whelgar Excavation Site, she once sent weekly letters about the work. Now Tarrel fears disaster has struck the camp. With dwarf authorities stretched thin, he turns to passing scouts to learn whether the diggers are alive.

sections.title: The Whelgar Dig
sections.body: East in the Wetlands, dwarves at the Whelgar Excavation Site seek ancient Titan relics and history. The crews work in the wild, where beasts and threats from below may find them. The site lies far from the main roads. Whatever stopped the letters has left the diggers beyond easy reach.

aliases: who gives in search of the excavation team
faq.answer: Tarrel Rockweaver is a dwarf in the Wetlands, worried because his wife Merrin has stopped writing from the eastern excavation site. He takes passing adventurers for scouts sent to learn what happened.
Merrin Rockweaver is a dwarf archaeologist working with the Whelgar Excavation team east of Menethil Harbor in the Wetlands. She wrote regularly to her husband until something stopped the letters.

faq.q: Where is the Whelgar Excavation Site?
faq.answer: The Whelgar Excavation Site lies east of Menethil Harbor and southwest of Dun Modr in the Wetlands. Rocky ridges surround it, far from the main road.

faq.q: Why did Merrin stop sending letters?
faq.answer: A threat at the dig cut the researchers off from normal courier routes and camp life, stopping Merrin's letters.

faq.q: Who is the 'Longbraid' mentioned by Tarrel?
faq.answer: Longbraid is a dwarven authority who promised to send scouts to check on the Whelgar Excavation team if contact failed. Tarrel assumes any capable adventurer who comes to help was sent by Longbraid.

faq.q: Is the excavation site safe to approach?
faq.answer: No. The Whelgar Excavation Site lies in dangerous Wetlands wilderness, and whatever stopped the team's weekly letters threatens anyone who reaches the dig.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Explorers' League takes pride in uncovering ancient history. Your kin at the Whelgar Excavation are in distress, and their plight calls for your attention.
As an Alliance member, you know dwarven outposts and research across the marshlands help guard the Wetlands from the dangers of the wild.
